name: Hermida Audio Technology
notes: Mosferatu first pedal in 2003; Zendrive released 2004; Zendrive 2 is later and must remain a distinct production state.

name: Pigtronix

name: Catalinbread

notes: Founded June 2003 through the Super Chili Picoso/ToneFactor relationship; later Portland production begins 2006.

name: Cusack Music
notes: Founded 2002; first Screamer and Screamer Fuzz records are anchored to September 2005.

name: MI Audio
dirt_evidence: Blues Pro; Crunch Box; Tube Zone; Classic Distortion; Blue Boy; G.I. Fuzz; Neo Fuzz
notes: Effects Database indexes 20 products and identifies a substantial dirt catalog; detailed founding chronology remains a follow-up target.

name: Menatone
dirt_evidence: Red Snapper; Blue Collar; King of the Brit and later dirt families
notes: Red Snapper debuted in 1996 as the first Menatone pedal; Blue Collar debuted 1997 as the second. Later PTP/Deluxe/Mini states remain separate.
